# Steve Hollar Concrete LLC

> Family-owned, 3rd generation concrete contractor based in Apopka, FL 32712, serving Orange, Seminole and Lake Counties in Central Florida. Father and son team with 85+ years of combined experience. Licensed and insured, BBB A+ accredited. Free estimates.

## Contact
- Phone: 321-229-1012
- Email: steveh@stevehollarconcretellc.com
- Website: https://www.stevehollarconcrete.com
- Free estimate form: https://www.stevehollarconcrete.com/contact

## Services (residential and commercial)
- Concrete slabs, foundations and footers
- Concrete driveways
- Concrete patios
- Sidewalks and walkways
- Site grading and cleanup
- Concrete for additions
- Block work
- Retaining walls
- Demolition and haul-away of old concrete
- Concrete repair

## Service area
- Orange County, FL (Apopka and surrounding cities)
- Seminole County, FL
- Lake County, FL
